name: io.github.ZhuLinsen/alphasift
title: AlphaSift
description: Multi-market quantitative stock screener and T+N falsification ledger with 14 read-only STDIO MCP tools across 7 equity markets (CN/US/HK/JP/KR/TW/IN).

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for Gemini LLM re-ranking (not required for deterministic rules screening).

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for DeepSeek LLM re-ranking.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for OpenAI-compatible LLM re-ranking.

environmentVariables.name: TUSHARE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Tushare Pro token for CN A-share market snapshots.
